title: Interpretable network finds a compact motif vocabulary read differently by cell type
summary: CNN-CR, an interpretable convolutional network, learned promoter motifs while predicting gene expression across 116 human biosamples. Dozens of motif families retained most predictive information and generalized to held-out cellular contexts, and the motifs were conserved and enriched at fine-mapped regulatory variants. Existing ChIP-seq and perturbation datasets supported context-dependent reader function; this is a computational preprint with no new wet-lab experiments.
ai_technology: CNN-CR interpretable convolutional neural network for motif learning and expression prediction
